scope: Release date of the Korean Sun & Moon expansion SM9 Tag Bolt (태그볼트) for the Korean items of set sm9.
rule: A date is applied only for the market its source names; a debut or availability date, never a production date, never borrowed from another language. Supplied by the collection owner from an internet research run; the research result named the sources but gave no addresses, so none are recorded here.

findings.label: ko sm9 Tag Bolt
findings.identityMatch: Three independent statements of the Korean release date: the Namu-wiki page 태그볼트 (발매일 : 2019년 1월 16일); the TCGBOX shop listing for the SM9 booster box (발매일 2019년 1월 16일 수요일 예정, 30 packs of 5 cards, 15,000 won); Korean blogs announcing '태그볼트가 1월 16일 발매됩니다', one of them pointing to Pokémon Korea for exactly this date.
findings.notes: About six weeks after Japan (SM9 there on 2018-12-07), the usual delay at the time. Some packs and boxes print 제조년월 2018년 12월, a production month that is not the release and is not used.
